stories.title: President Trump orders a Marine rapid response force to Middle East
stories.summary: NPR's Jane Arraf reports on developments in the war in the Middle East.

stories.title: Reactions from the hometown of man who attacked the synagogue in Michigan
stories.summary: The man who attacked a synagogue in Michigan lost family members in an Israeli strike in Lebanon. Relatives and neighbors in his hometown share their views on his actions.

stories.title: A Game Challenges Californians To Find A Working Payphone
stories.summary: When was the last time you saw a payphone? For most people it's probably been a while. In California, there are more than 2000 working payphones. A game challenges the public to find them.

stories.title: Your Child's Pediatrician May Be Able To Provide Literacy Screenings
stories.summary: Sara Bode of Nationwide Children's Hospital in Ohio speaks with NPR's Emily Kwong about why many pediatric centers have started screening kids for literacy skills.

stories.title: Unlike past eras, anti-Muslim GOP rhetoric draws little pushback from party leaders
stories.summary: A growing chorus of Republicans in Congress have embraced rhetoric against Muslims and sharia law. But unlike in past years, their remarks have faced little public pushback from leadership.

stories.title: New Music Friday: Johnny Blue Skies and the Dark Clouds
stories.summary: The country singer-songwriter formerly known as Sturgill Simpson has a new album out under his current stage name, Johnny Blue Skies and the Dark Clouds.
